All four had previously worked on the successful film adaptation of "Cabaret" earlier in the same year.  According to Minnelli, it was "the first filmed concert on television".  Singer sponsored the production, even though the producers did their best to keep any of the sponsors from seeing the rehearsals for fear of them pulling out due to Minnelli's short skirts.
